note: Example data: an invented online cookware store, not a real business. Every number in expected_output.json follows from this input.
request: Hey Claude, I just added the "poas-profit-report" skill. Work out POAS for every campaign over the last 30 days from my orders export and cost sheet, and tell me which campaigns and products lose money after costs. The ad platforms get the order total with tax and shipping. The Meta prospecting campaign has a minimum ROAS of 2.0.
value_basis: order total with tax and shipping

cost_sheet.title: Starter kitchen bundle (skillet, chef's knife, board)

orders_export.note: One row per order line, as in a Shopify orders CSV. Order-level fields (shipping_charged, tax, landing_site) sit on the order's first line only.
